title: RLAIF-V: Open-Source AI Feedback Leads to Super GPT-4V Trustworthiness
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈审计研究者
one_line: RLAIF-V: Open-Source AI Feedback Leads to Super GPT-4V Trustworthiness releases open-source visual-language-model feedback over image-text responses; synthetic labels target hallucination and trustworthiness for preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and feedback audit.
开放视觉语言模型生成的图文偏好反馈，用于降低视觉幻觉并训练多模态奖励模型。
why: 开放视觉语言模型生成的图文偏好反馈，用于降低视觉幻觉并训练多模态奖励模型。
inclusion_reason: 开放视觉语言模型生成的图文偏好反馈，用于降低视觉幻觉并训练多模态奖励模型。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reducing visual hallucination usually needs costly human corrections or proprietary model judgments. RLAIF-V asks whether peer open-source multimodal models can generate preference feedback that makes another vision-language model more trustworthy.

The decision boundary is whether a candidate answer's image-grounded claims should be retained or rejected. It targets hallucination and helpfulness in image–text conversation, not a general guarantee of factual correctness.

降低视觉幻觉通常需要昂贵的人工纠错或专有模型裁判。RLAIF-V 探索同级开源多模态模型能否生成偏好反馈，从而让另一视觉语言模型更可信。

其判定边界是候选回答中与图像相关的主张应被保留还是拒绝。它面向图文对话中的幻觉和帮助性，并不保证一般意义上的事实正确。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: RLAIF-V constructs synthetic visual preference data with open-source MLLMs rather than human labels: it decomposes a response into factual claims, converts claims to questions, and lets a labeler assess them against the image before deriving a preferred answer. The contract is AI feedback conditioned on this decomposition and model pool; it is reusable for hallucination-oriented preference learning but is not human preference data.
RLAIF-V 不用人工标签，而用开源多模态模型构造合成视觉偏好数据：它将回答拆为事实主张，把主张改写为问题，再让标注模型对照图像逐项评估，最后得到优选回答。其契约是受这一拆分过程和模型池约束的人工智能反馈，可用于面向幻觉的偏好学习，但不是人类偏好数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Generate candidate image–question answers with open MLLMs. 2. Split each answer into self-contained factual claims and convert claims into questions, using a small Llama 3 model trained from 2K Llama 3 70B examples. 3. Ask an open-source visual labeler to verify each question against the image and aggregate the verdicts into preference pairs. 4. Train an MLLM on those pairs and optionally use its reward to select among inference-time samples.

The outputs are AI-labeled preference data, aligned models, and a self-feedback selector. Reproduction needs the generator/labeler checkpoints and prompts; changing them changes the label source.

1. 用开源多模态模型生成图像—问题的候选回答。2. 将每个回答拆为自足的事实主张并改写为问题；这一拆分器由二千条 Llama 3 70B 样例训练的小型 Llama 3 模型实现。3. 请开源视觉标注模型逐项对照图像核验，并汇总结果形成偏好对。4. 用这些对训练多模态模型，且可用其奖励在推断时从多个样本中选择。

产物是人工智能标注的偏好数据、对齐模型和自反馈选择器。复现须锁定生成器、标注器检查点和提示；更换它们就改变了标签来源。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: decomposed open-source feedback improves visual trustworthiness. Across six reported benchmarks, RLAIF-V 7B reduces object hallucination by 80.7% and overall hallucination by 33.7%; the paper also reports that its 12B model outperforms GPT-4V on four named trustworthiness benchmarks. These are paper-specific benchmark comparisons, not evidence that its synthetic labels equal human feedback or eliminate hallucination.
主张：拆分后的开源反馈能提升视觉可信度。在报告的六个基准上，RLAIF-V 7B 将对象幻觉降低 80.7%，总体幻觉降低 33.7%；论文还报告其 12B 模型在四个具名可信度基准上优于 GPT-4V。这些是论文特定基准的比较，并不证明合成标签等同于人工反馈或能消除幻觉。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Standard RLAIF often asks one judge for an overall preference. RLAIF-V turns answer claims into checkable visual questions before aggregation, and uses open peer models for both feedback and inference-time selection. Its novelty is the decomposition-based open feedback pipeline, not a new ground-truth vision verifier.
常规 RLAIF 常让一个裁判直接给整体偏好。RLAIF-V 先把回答主张变成可核验的视觉问题，再汇总，并用开源同级模型同时提供反馈和推断时选择。其新意是基于拆分的开放反馈管线，而不是新的视觉真值验证器。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Author-stated: training MLLMs incurs meaningful compute cost, and the improved models still hallucinate. Treat the reward as a selector with residual error, not as a safety certificate.

The feedback depends on open labelers' visual competence and on claim splitting. Poor extraction or a shared model blind spot can turn a false claim into an accepted pair; inspect claim-level agreement and target-domain failures.

作者指出：训练多模态模型仍有显著计算成本，改进后的模型也仍会产生幻觉。应把该奖励当作有残余误差的选择器，而不是安全证书。

反馈依赖开源标注器的视觉能力和主张拆分质量。差的抽取或共享的模型盲区可能把错误主张变为被接受的文本对；应检查主张级一致性和目标领域失效。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use RLAIF-V to prototype open-source hallucination-oriented preference learning when human visual annotation is unavailable. Record the claim splitter, labeler, and selection budget, and evaluate against independent human or evidence-grounded checks. Do not report its labels as human judgments or use them unreviewed in high-stakes visual decisions.
适用于在缺少人工视觉标注时，试验开源的面向幻觉偏好学习。应记录主张拆分器、标注器和选择预算，并以独立人工或证据约束检查评估。不要把其标签报告成人类判断，也不要未经复核用于高风险视觉决策。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Feedback is generated by open MLLMs, not people.
  2. A response is split into claims before visual judging.
  3. The split/conversion model is trained from 2K Llama 3 70B examples.
  4. RLAIF-V 7B reports 80.7% less object hallucination.
  5. The authors explicitly state that hallucinations remain.

1. 反馈由开源多模态模型生成，而非人。
  2. 回答在视觉裁判前被拆为主张。
  3. 拆分与改写模型由二千条 Llama 3 70B 样例训练。
  4. RLAIF-V 7B 报告对象幻觉降低 80.7%。
  5. 作者明确说明幻觉仍然存在。
